tasks.notes:
# Task #65 — Docs: remove the compatibility window from CLAUDE.md and README.md

## Context

The Ralph→Cairn rename's compatibility layer (LEGACY export, dual data-dir/config-file
resolution, dual binary symlink, `cairn migrate`, the removal-marker test) was already
fully removed from source in prior tasks (#60–#64). This task was pure documentation
catch-up: CLAUDE.md and README.md still described a compatibility layer that no longer
exists in code. Verified via `grep -rn "LEGACY\|ralph\.json\|\.ralph\b" src/` (excluding
the permanent `NOTES_TEMP_PREFIX`/`.ralph_` exception) — zero hits, confirming the docs
were describing dead code.

## CLAUDE.md changes

- **Deleted sections**: "Branding and the legacy layout" (+ its "temp-file prefix" and
  "narration socket" subsections), "The `cairn migrate` command", "The compatibility
  window" (+ "The removal marker" subsection).
- **Kept**: "Pin/unpin procedure for self-modifying rounds" verbatim in structure, but
  scrubbed live `ralph.json`/`~/.local/bin/ralph` references (those paths no longer
  exist) while keeping the historical "e.g. the Ralph→Cairn rename" mention as context
  for *why* the procedure exists.
- **Folded what survived** into a new "Branding" bullet under Architecture → Key design
  patterns, pointing at `src/brand.ts`'s `BRAND` fields and `NOTES_TEMP_PREFIX`.
- **Added** a Conventions bullet documenting `.ralph_task_<id>_notes.md` /
  `NOTES_TEMP_PREFIX` as a deliberate permanent exception (not a legacy leftover) —
  matches the doc comment already on `NOTES_TEMP_PREFIX` in `src/brand.ts` from task #63.
- Updated the "What is Cairn" opener, the install.sh comment, the `.cairn/` layout
  diagram (dropped "or .ralph/ on projects not yet migrated"), the config-loading
  bullet (dropped "or legacy ralph.json"), and the Agent workflow section (dropped the
  `.ralph/tasks.json` parenthetical and the `ralph task ...` equivalence note).

## README.md changes

- Deleted the entire "Migrating from Ralph" section and both links to it (opener,
  install section).
- Fixed the install section: only `~/.local/bin/cairn` is symlinked now.
- Dropped `cairn migrate` from the command table and the `ralph` compatibility-symlink
  note beneath it.
- Removed legacy-layout notes from: Personal Agent Instructions (`.ralph/instructions.md`
  parenthetical), Configuration (`or legacy ralph.json`), Project Root Detection
  (`.ralph/` in the walk-upward step), and both file-structure diagrams (installation
  tree: dropped `migrate.ts` and the `LEGACY` mention on `brand.ts`/`config.ts`, and the
  install.sh comment; per-project tree: dropped `or .ralph/...` and `or legacy
  ralph.json`).
- Fixed the narration paragraphs: removed the `/tmp/ralph-tts.sock` fallback narrative
  and the `RALPH_NARRATE_SOCKET` env-var fallback claim — verified against
  `lib/cairn_narrate_server.py` (`argparse` default only reads `CAIRN_NARRATE_SOCKET`)
  and `src/narration.ts` (`findNarrationSocketPath`/`findNarrationPidFile` have no
  legacy branch, just hook-file-or-`BRAND.socket`).

## docs/parallel-execution-rfc.md

Fixed the one `ralph` reference in the author line ("written when the tool was still
named Ralph" → removed; kept "(iteration 6)").

## Verification

- `grep -rni ralph CLAUDE.md README.md docs/parallel-execution-rfc.md` — only 2 hits
  left, both intentional per the task spec: the `.ralph_task_<id>_notes.md` permanent
  exception note in CLAUDE.md Conventions, and the historical "Ralph→Cairn rename"
  mention in the Pin/unpin section.
- `bun test` — 805 pass, 0 fail, 29 files. Identical to baseline (doc-only change, no
  test files touched).
- Confirmed untouched: `.cairn/tasks.completed.json`, `.cairn_iterations.log`,
  `.cairn_tasks_snapshot.json`, `.cairn/reviews/round-*.md`, other
  `.ralph_task_*_notes.md`, `audit/`.
- Did not modify `cairn.json`'s `healthCheck` and did not run `./install.sh`.

## Remaining work

One task remains in `tasks.json`: #66 ("Decide the fate of resolveAnthropicApiKeyChain
— no production callers remain"), unrelated to this task's scope. `.cairn_complete`
was NOT created.

tasks.title: Decide the fate of resolveAnthropicApiKeyChain — no production callers remain
tasks.description: Task #51 deleted warnIfLegacyApiKey and its two call sites (src/commands/narrate.ts, src/commands/run.ts), which were the only consumers of resolveAnthropicApiKeyChain(). The function is still exported from src/config.ts and covered by test/config.test.ts, but nothing in src/ calls it — the resolution is now purely documentary, mirroring the same chain in lib/cairn_narrate_server.py (see task #59). Either (a) delete the helper, its AnthropicApiKeyResolution type, and its tests, leaving the Python server as the single implementation, or (b) keep it and give it a real caller — e.g. have runNarrate/runRun pass the resolved key into the narration server env instead of relying on the child process re-reading the environment. Do NOT normalize onto plain ANTHROPIC_API_KEY under either option: the loop deliberately blanks that name to force Max-plan usage. Sequence this after #59 so both sides of the mirror are decided together.
